title: justicia tenella
intro: Justicia tenella, commonly known as the Poor Man's Barometer, is a plant species native to tropical regions. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and act as an expectorant, making it useful for treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Justicia tenella include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
